segments.name: digital printing solutions
segments.description: Develops and sells digital printing systems, inks, software and services to garment and fabric printers, brands and fulfillers for on-demand textile production.
segments.evidence: Our solutions include our proprietary digital printing systems, curing systems, ink, and other consumables, associated software and value-added services.

revenueModel.text: Customers and channel partners pay for printing systems, ink and consumables, service, software and training, or a fixed price per impression under the All-Inclusive Click model.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates revenues from sales of systems, operating leases, consumables and services, including software subscriptions and transaction-based revenues.

changes.text: In 2023 through 2025 the restructuring plans included a phasing out of legacy platforms.
changes.evidence: Included in this restructuring is a workforce reduction and a phasing out of legacy platforms.
